summary: GFL Environmental Inc. filed a Form 6-K on July 2, 2026, announcing a quarterly cash dividend of US$0.0169 per share for Q2 2026, payable July 31, 2026, to shareholders of record July 13, 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, activist, tender, restructuring, or other special-situation elements. The registrant is the issuer making a standard dividend payout; no deal terms, premiums, advisors, or structural changes are present. No risk-arb or event-driven angle applies.
